purpose: Fantasy-only VNF biome templates. These are not Earth regions and must not be treated as real-world ecology.

biomes.label: Highmist Spires
biomes.climate: cold suspended mist with strong vertical currents
biomes.terrain: towering stone fins and hanging root bridges
biomes.vegetation: needle-veils, bell fronds, cliff ribbons, cloud moss

biomes.label: Glassmarsh
biomes.terrain: shallow reflective flats over flexible mineral skin
biomes.vegetation: mirror reeds, bubblefans, thread-vines, soft prisms

biomes.label: Ember Drylands
biomes.climate: hot dry air with nocturnal heat release from the ground
biomes.terrain: porous emberstone shelves and dust hollows
biomes.vegetation: heat-folds, ember veins, wax fans, dusk bulbs
biomes.fauna: shade burrowers, heat sails, crack runners

biomes.label: Chimeforest
biomes.climate: cool humid still-air pockets broken by resonant gusts
biomes.terrain: interlocked hollow trunks and suspended membrane paths
biomes.vegetation: chime trunks, veil-crowns, echo fronds, hanging threadbloom

biomes.label: Twilight Shelf
biomes.climate: permanent low-angle lumen with sharp thermal gradients
biomes.terrain: broad terraces above a dim luminous basin
biomes.vegetation: shade fans, glow knots, thin silver membranes
biomes.fauna: edge walkers, dusk floaters, shelf burrowers

biomes.label: Deepveil Basin
biomes.climate: dense warm mist under very low direct lumen
biomes.terrain: sunken basin with soft mineral mud and giant root arches
biomes.vegetation: giant veil plates, pulse vines, ember-spored mats
biomes.fauna: slow lantern beasts, mist swimmers, rootbound colonies
